description: Traffic Signal Damage is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. One time export of traffic signal damages. Signal Location Number is based on location data from the Traffic Signals Inventory – Locations. Can be associated to specific geographic location of the damaged pole or cabinet using Traffic Signals Inventory Pole Cabinet Locations. This data may change periodically. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are equipement, damage, beta, asset, tmc. The table has 5 columns. The portal shows 2019-03-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
